title: Listen to Bam Keith's new single, "PS5 INTERLUDE," featuring Davin
htmlContent:
Kansas City fast-rising artist Bam Keith shares a new single, "PS5 INTERLUDE," featuring Davin from his new album "Twin Colours." This new release follows the release of his smooth, catchy hooks for "Way of Life." 

On his new single PS5 INTERLUDE, Bam Keith shares his musical ability with the world. His flow has a Missouri rap tempo that is unique and appealing when coupled with the song's production. "PS5 INTERLUDE" is the latest extract from the Twin Colours album, a 14-track album featuring contributions from talented musicians.

It showcases Bam Keith's impressive songwriting abilities and will undoubtedly be etched into everyone's head after one listens. The album welcomes a miscellaneous pack of artists with a deep connection ranging from stars like Nino Lee to acclaimed acts like Kuttybear, LA Mitchell, and many others.

Everything you need to know about Bam Keith:

Meet Brandon Thomas, better known as Bam Keith, the award-winning producer, songwriter, and artist. You might not have heard of Bam Keith, but you've listened to his music. The rising rapper/singer and producer hasn't had an easy ride. Born and raised in Kansas City, Missouri, Bam Keith became homeless in their junior year. Aged 16, he sat in the rain watching movers evict his family.
